finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands `retryCount`. That crashed the link stage outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on any non-boolean `backoffEnabled`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled, same as before.

The rest was just deprecation and dedupe chatter, harmless. Build finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
